title: Tech Note: 4D Write, Programming Styles, and Entry Control (part II)
featured_technology: BLOB to list / LIST TO BLOB

historical_commentary.text: The classic 4D Write plug-in referenced here has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro (introduced in later 4D versions) with a substantially different, more modern document model, making this note's specific styling and BLOB-based list techniques largely obsolete for current 4D document development.
related_updates: 4D Write has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro, which uses a different, more modern document/formatting model than the classic 4D Write plug-in described here
